bio.text: Jeffrey Hulum III, a Democrat, has represented District 119 in the Mississippi House of Representatives since 2022 and is the Democratic candidate for Mississippi's 4th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election.
He is a Gulfport native and a U.S. Army veteran.
He founded Extend A Hand, Help A Friend, an organization that works on food insecurity in Mississippi.

sources.title: Meet the Candidates for Mississippi's 4th Congressional District in the Nov. 3 Elections
